motion.name: control-transition
motion.purpose: Background and border feedback; respect reduced motion.

components.name: Search field
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:8px;font:14px "IBM Plex Sans",Arial,sans-serif}.ds-field input{min-height:46px;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid var(--control,#c7c5bf);border-radius:6px;background:white;color:var(--text,#252b31);font:inherit}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--text,#252b31);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Current view on an ink-blue rail.
components.css: .ds-nav{display:grid;gap:8px;padding:16px;background:var(--shell,#243d50)}.ds-nav button{font:14px "IBM Plex Sans",Arial,sans-serif;min-height:48px;padding:12px;text-align:left;color:#e2e8ec;background:transparent;border:0;border-radius:6px}.ds-nav button[aria-current=page]{background:#3c5365;color:white}.ds-nav button:hover{background:#344e61}.ds-nav button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid white;outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Food record
components.description: Food identity and stock on a white work surface.
components.css: .ds-food{font:14px "IBM Plex Sans",Arial,sans-serif;padding:16px 20px;border:1px solid var(--border,#dedbd4);border-radius:12px;background:white;color:var(--text,#252b31)}.ds-food h2{font-size:16px;margin:0 0 8px}.ds-food div{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px}.ds-food button{font:inherit;min-height:44px;padding:9px 14px;border:1px solid var(--control,#c7c5bf);border-radius:6px;background:var(--ground,#f5f2ec)}.ds-food button:hover{background:var(--active,#e5eaf0)}.ds-food button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--text,#252b31);outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview: A practical workspace with warm surfaces, ink-blue navigation and clearly aligned food information.
keyCharacteristics: Persistent navigation and compact stock filters.
Warm neutral work surfaces and restrained state colors.
Consistent labeled actions across records and editors.
